name: Kling Motion Control
description: Transfer movements from a reference video to any character image. Pro mode delivers higher quality output, ideal for complex dance moves and gestures.

action.description: Transfer movements from a reference video to any character image. Pro mode delivers higher quality output, ideal for complex dance moves and gestures.
action.name: fal-ai/kling-video/v2.6/pro/motion-control

character_orientation.description: Controls whether the output character's orientation matches the reference image or video. 'video': orientation matches reference video - better for complex motions (max 30s). 'image': orientation matches reference image - better for following camera movements (max 10s).
character_orientation.title: Character Orientation

keep_original_sound.description: Whether to keep the original sound from the reference video.
keep_original_sound.title: Keep Original Sound

prompt.description: Text prompt for the video generation. Can include positive and negative descriptions to add elements and motion effects.
prompt.title: Prompt
